page.layout: One column of running text with marginal notes down the left margin; a catchword at the bottom right. Printed page 86 on the scan.

main_text.p: a Vide notas.jam rege AEgypti, determinatisque inter eos imperii finibus, convenerat Iudaeos ad Babylonem pertinere. Ira cum Ioachis, exactis in regno annis undecim, * filioe-iusdem nominis locum fecisset, ifq; regis Babylonii in se iram concitasset, Deo nimirum agente, cui constitutum erat Iudę[?] gentem captivitati & internecioni da-re, Nabuchodonosor Hierosolymam cum exercitu ingressus, Hierofo-lymaac[?] templum vastatit.urbem murosque ac templum solo stravit: auri immensū modum & sacra ornamenta vel publica vel privata, puberesq; omnes virilis ac muliebris sexus transtulit: relictis, quorum imbecillitas aut ætas fastidio victoribus fuit. Quæ turba inutilis servitio, exercendis colendisque agris, ne incultum esset solum, deputata. Eisdemque rex Sedechias præpositus, 4.Reg.25.ademptis viribus inani tantum umbra regii nominis concessa. Sed Ioachis tribus mensibus tempus imperii habuit. Is cum populo Babylonem translatus, & in carcerem conjectus est: trigesimum post annum emissus, atque a rege in amicitiam receptus, mensaque & consiliis participatus, non sine solatio depulsae calamitatis decessit. Interea Sedechias rex

page.notes: Printed marginal notes, left side: "a Vide notas."; "Hierofo-lymaac templum vastatit." (the word "lymaac" is doubtful); "b falfum[?]" marks the note at "urbem"; "4.Reg.25." beside "deputata"; "c hæc ipsa babentur in fonte." beside lines 19–21; "dxxxvij." and "Sig." beside lines 22–24; "Hier. 39." and "Hier. 52." at the foot of the column. Several of these were not fully legible at the scan's resolution and are reproduced as best read. The text line "Ioachis tribus" was read as "Ioachistribus" with a missing space; "ifq;" may be "ifque". The reading "Iudę[?]" is doubtful. The star after "undecim" is a printed mark. Not yet verified: the note "b falfum[?]" and the "c hæc ipsa" note text.
